guidelines.detail: same as LRN-034 (The description presents the activities after logging in without stating an order, while the reference has a parallel split and join absent from the generated model. This is essentially the same guidance as LRN-034.)

same as LRN-016 (The description separately states selecting a course and completing its registration, while P5 pairs a completion label with a selection label. This supports preserving the described action in each element label. The proposed guidance substantially overlaps learned rule LRN-016, which requires labels to preserve the stated action and not substitute a different meaning.)

same as LRN-001 (The missing flows show that described transitions and continuations were not preserved, including the required synchronization. The guideline is not tied to this process and is already stated essentially the same way in LRN-001.)

same as LRN-016 (The description distinguishes actions such as selecting a course, selecting one of the courses presented, and tweeting to friends. The generated labels substitute or conflate actions in the matched pairs. This is already captured by learned guideline LRN-016.)

same as LRN-016 (The records show action-label mismatches: tweeting was matched to connecting an account, completing registration to inviting friends, and checking availability to selecting a course. This is essentially covered by learned guideline LRN-016.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that two or more actions occur at the same time, or that one action is independent of another after a shared prerequisite: Model the actions on separate branches from a parallel gateway. Use a parallel join only before a continuation that requires all those branches to finish.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description lists two or more activities after the same prerequisite without specifying an order between them

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient: label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves those stated details and does not substitute a different action or meaning
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes selecting an item from subsequently completing a transaction involving that item

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description lays out activities in an order, or requires several activities to finish before a later stage or process end.: Connect the activities with sequence flows that preserve the stated order; when every required activity must finish before proceeding, synchronize their paths with a parallel gateway.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states activities in an order or says that multiple required activities must be completed before a later step

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description names multiple required activities that must be completed before a later activity, without specifying an order among them: Model the activities as separate parallel branches and synchronize them before the later activity.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description requires two or more distinct activities before a shared continuation and specifies no order between them
